technique_name: Write a story beginning with the words "The sun shone brightly".
description: The sun shone brightly in the sky. Its rays shone down on the small town below, its people bustling about their daily lives. The trees were blossoming, flowers in full bloom and the birds chirped in the clear sky. It was a peaceful morning in the town, and the people were happy and content. Suddenly, something strange happened. An old man appeared on the street, walking slowly and purposefully towards the town square. The townsfolk stopped and watched curiously as the man marched past.
